components.note: Durrett Step 1 (p. 18): signed simple functions on finite-measure pieces of a sigma-finite space and the representation-independence claim. The handbook defines the nonnegative simple integral on an arbitrary measure space, proves representation independence, and identifies the source's signed finite-support stage through the bounded-stage identity of the bridge theorem.

Durrett Lemma 1.4.1 (i)-(iii) and Lemma 1.4.2 (iv)-(vi), p. 19: additivity, scaling and order for nonnegative simple functions are proved here; real scalars, a.e. order, a.e. equality and the absolute bound for the source's signed simple functions are the integrable-function laws of thm:p15-signed-integral-laws. The abstract form of Lemma 1.4.2 is replaced by direct proofs of its three conclusions at every stage.

Durrett Step 3 definition (sup over bounded h with finite-measure positive region), the notation int_E f = int f 1_E and the a.e. definition (pp. 18, 21) are present; the bridge proves the source's Step 3 value equals the handbook integral on sigma-finite spaces (Lemma 1.4.4).
